general/sLogLevel.label: Log detail
general/sLogLevel.desc: How much the server writes to its log. 'info' is right for normal play.

general/bConsole.label: Server console
general/bConsole.desc: Lets you type admin commands into the server window.

LiveServices/bAnnounceServer.label: List on public server browser
LiveServices/bAnnounceServer.desc: Keep this off when playing with friends; they join by IP.

GameServer/sPassword.label: Join password
GameServer/sPassword.desc: Friends need this to join. Leave empty to let anyone join.

GameServer/sAdminPassword.label: Admin password
GameServer/sAdminPassword.desc: Joining with this password gives admin rights.

GameServer/uMaxPlayerCount.label: Max players
GameServer/uMaxPlayerCount.desc: More than 8 is not recommended by the Skyrim Together team.

GameServer/uPort.label: Port
GameServer/uPort.desc: Friends outside your home network need this port (UDP) forwarded on your router. Default 10578.

GameServer/bPremiumMode.label: 60 updates per second
GameServer/bPremiumMode.desc: Smoother sync at a small CPU/bandwidth cost. Off = 30 per second.

Gameplay/uDifficulty.label: Difficulty (everyone)
Gameplay/uDifficulty.desc: Forced for all players. Enemies don't scale with party size, so 3 players can handle a higher difficulty than solo.

Gameplay/bEnableXpSync.label: Share combat XP
Gameplay/bEnableXpSync.desc: Everyone in the party gets XP from kills.

Gameplay/bAutoPartyJoin.label: Auto-join party
Gameplay/bAutoPartyJoin.desc: Players join the party automatically when there's only one.

Gameplay/bEnableDeathSystem.label: Co-op death system
Gameplay/bEnableDeathSystem.desc: Downed players respawn instead of reloading. Only turn off if another mod replaces death.

Gameplay/bSyncPlayerHomes.label: Shared house chests
Gameplay/bSyncPlayerHomes.desc: Chests and displays in player homes are shared — handy as a group stash.

Gameplay/bSyncPlayerCalendar.label: Sync in-game date
Gameplay/bSyncPlayerCalendar.desc: Everyone uses the date of whoever is furthest ahead when they connect.

Gameplay/uTimeScale.label: Time scale
Gameplay/uTimeScale.desc: In-game seconds per real second. Default 20. Changing it can make the game unstable.
Gameplay/uTimeScale.warn: Values other than 20 can cause instability.

Gameplay/bEnableGreetings.label: NPC greetings
Gameplay/bEnableGreetings.desc: NPCs greet you as you pass. Off by default because it gets spammy with dialogue sync.

Gameplay/bEnableMiscQuestSync.label: Sync side errands (experimental)
Gameplay/bEnableMiscQuestSync.desc: Syncs Miscellaneous journal quests. Radiant errands can pick different targets per player, so journals may disagree.

Gameplay/bEnableItemDrops.label: Sync dropped items (experimental)
Gameplay/bEnableItemDrops.desc: Items you drop appear for friends so they can pick them up. Can duplicate or lose items.
Gameplay/bEnableItemDrops.warn: Experimental — save before handing over valuables.

ModPolicy/bEnableModCheck.label: Enforce matching mods
ModPolicy/bEnableModCheck.desc: Refuses players whose mods don't match Data/loadorder.txt on the server PC.

Display/bFull Screen.label: Exclusive fullscreen
Display/bFull Screen.desc: Turn off and use Borderless for easy alt-tab to Discord.

Display/bBorderless.label: Borderless window
Display/bBorderless.desc: Fullscreen-looking window that alt-tabs instantly. Recommended for co-op.

Display/iVSyncPresentInterval.label: VSync
Display/iVSyncPresentInterval.desc: Keeps FPS at or below your refresh rate. Skyrim's physics break above 60 FPS without a frame-rate fix mod.

Display/bFXAAEnabled.label: Anti-aliasing (FXAA)
Display/bFXAAEnabled.desc: Use either TAA or FXAA, not both.

Interface/bDialogueSubtitles.label: Dialogue subtitles
Interface/bDialogueSubtitles.desc: Recommended in co-op so nobody misses quest lines while chatting.

General/uExterior Cell Buffer.label: Exterior cell buffer
General/uExterior Cell Buffer.desc: How many outdoor cells stay in memory. 36 is the default for 1.6+ — don't raise it without a reason.

Papyrus/bEnableLogging.label: Script logging
Papyrus/bEnableLogging.desc: Writes Papyrus logs for troubleshooting. Turn off afterwards.
